links.title: UPSIDA — Present Rates
links.note: Current per-sqm allotment rates across UPSIDA industrial areas.

detail.whatItGives: The authoritative current rate table by industrial area — distinct from PropertyHub's per-plot indicative pricing.
detail.typicalUse: Quoting the official current rate for an industrial area, not just an indicative plot price.
quirks: A staging-domain copy of this page (stagingupsida.com) surfaces in search results — always use the onlineupsida.com production URL, never the staging one

links.title: IGRSUP — Circle Rates (Stamp & Registration)
links.note: Official circle-rate lookup for stamp duty/valuation across UP.

detail.owner: Stamp & Registration Department, Govt. of UP
detail.whatItGives: District/tehsil/locality-level circle rates used for stamp duty and property valuation — the field a plain-text search for 'circle rate' should surface.
detail.typicalUse: Estimating stamp duty or minimum registration value for a land transaction.

links.title: UPSIDA Operating Manual
links.note: UPSIDA's internal operating procedures, publicly posted.

detail.whatItGives: The procedural rulebook UPSIDA staff themselves operate under — allotment process, transfer rules, penalty clauses.
detail.typicalUse: Settling a procedural dispute or question by citing UPSIDA's own manual rather than informal practice.
quirks: publishedDate left blank deliberately — the filename says '2023' but that isn't a confirmed publication date, so it isn't asserted here; source it from the document itself if it's needed

links.title: Uttar Pradesh Revenue Code, 2006
links.note: The consolidated state revenue/land law — 39 prior laws merged into one code.
links.issuingAuthority: Govt. of UP (U.P. Act No. 8 of 2012)

detail.owner: Govt. of UP — hosted on the central India Code repository
detail.whatItGives: The full statutory text governing land classification, revenue records, mutation, and related land-law questions across UP.
detail.typicalUse: Citing statutory basis for a land-classification or revenue-record question.
quirks: Complicated date history — drafted as a 2006 bill, but only received presidential assent on 29 Nov 2012 as U.P. Act No. 8 of 2012, published in the UP Gazette on 12 Dec 2012 (the date used here). Different sections then commenced on different notified dates — e.g. several core sections commenced only from 18 Dec 2015. Do not cite '2006' as the enactment date; verify which sections are in force for the specific provision you're citing.

links.title: UP RERA — Real Estate Regulatory Authority
links.note: Registered-project and promoter lookup — due diligence on any developer counterparty.

detail.owner: Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (under the RERA Act, 2016)
detail.whatItGives: Searchable register of real estate projects and promoters/agents in UP, with registration status and complaint history — the public record for checking whether a developer and their project are actually registered and in good standing.
detail.typicalUse: Due diligence on a private developer counterparty — relevant to business park, plug-and-play shed, and private-township proposals where a developer partner is involved.
quirks: Registration lookups are served from a separate uprera.azurewebsites.net application — the domain change mid-journey is expected, not a phishing redirect
Covers real estate promoters, not industrial allottees — a unit taking a UPSIDA plot will not appear here
